**Yoga Coach Feedback for Warrior I (Virabhadrasana I):**

*"Great effort in your Warrior I today! This is such a powerful pose, and I can see you’re really engaging with it. Let’s refine a few things to help you find even more strength and stability in your alignment. Here’s what we’ll work on together:"*

1. **Spine Alignment:** *"I notice your spine is slightly rounded or leaning forward. In Warrior I, we want to keep the spine long and tall—imagine a string pulling the crown of your head toward the sky. Try gently lifting your chest and drawing your shoulders back, as if you’re opening your heart to the front of the room. This will help protect your lower back and create a strong, grounded foundation."*

2. **Arm Position:** *"Your arms are close, but let’s straighten them fully overhead. Reach up through your fingertips like you’re trying to touch the ceiling, and keep your biceps by your ears. If your shoulders feel tight, you can widen your hands slightly—just keep the energy reaching upward. This will help lengthen your side body and deepen the stretch."*

3. **Knee Over Ankle:** *"Your front knee is drifting slightly forward past your ankle. To protect your knee joint, make sure it stays stacked directly over your ankle. You might need to adjust your stance—try stepping your back foot a little farther back or pressing more firmly into the outer edge of your back foot. This will give you more stability and prevent strain."*

*"Remember, alignment is about finding balance—not perfection. Take a deep breath in, and as you exhale, see if you can make these small adjustments. You’ve got this! Let’s hold for a few more breaths and feel the strength in this pose."*

*"How does that feel? Any questions or areas you’d like to focus on?"*

*(Always end with encouragement!)*
*"You’re doing fantastic—keep up that mindful awareness, and your Warrior I will keep growing stronger with each practice."* 🙏✨
